verdict.rationale: Ad-hoc grouping and filtering by high-cardinality fields is a fair question for an observability platform, but the pack has no Datadog documentation describing it. The only related evidence is a community remark that a field must be clicked to become a custom search dimension. That describes defining a dimension first, which is the opposite of the story, and nothing addresses high-cardinality fields such as user id or request id.

support.subject: As a developer, I can group and filter by high-cardinality fields (user id, request id) without pre-aggregating or defining indexes first
